section.title: Code navigation and errors
section.subtitle: Definitions, references, implementations and hover; errors introduced by an edit are reported to the model
field.enabled.label: Enable code navigation and errors
field.enabled.help: When off, the lsp tool only returns a note and no diagnostics are injected after edits (no need to disable the whole plugin).
field.servers.label: Server list (one line of JSON)
field.servers.help: Leave it empty to use the built-in table (typescript / pyright / rust / go / clangd / json / yaml). One server per entry: id and command are required, extensions is required (the file types it claims), args / markers / languageId are optional. The same id overrides a built-in entry; a new id goes before the built-ins (it claims those extensions first).
field.servers.problem: This list cannot be read right now: {problem}
field.idleSeconds.label: Shut down an idle language server after (seconds)
field.idleSeconds.help: The floor is 30 seconds: anything shorter would kill a query that is still running.
field.diagnostics.label: Report newly introduced errors after an edit
field.diagnostics.help: One baseline before the write, one after it, and only the ERRORs introduced this time are reported (details come with the next request).
field.maxLocations.label: Results per query
field.maxLocations.help: Anything beyond is cut off with a note saying how many are not listed; the result is then cut again at 16,000 characters.
field.statusButton.label: Show server status
field.status.label: Right now
